title: Reinforcement Learning in Operational Research: A Technical Review and Practical Roadmap
abstract: arXiv:2609.24750v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The growing demand for real-time, data-driven decision-making in complex and dynamic systems is placing increasing pressure on traditional Operational Research (OR) methodologies. Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a complementary approach, offering strong learning and computational capabilities for sequential decision-making in dynamic and uncertain environments. Recent research shows an increasing interest in integrating RL with OR to address dynamic decision-making problems, enhance heuristic and exact methods for combinatorial optimization, and support the development of digital replicas of operational systems. The overarching goal across these efforts is to leverage the learning capabilities of RL to strengthen traditional OR algorithms, improving solution quality, computational efficiency, and robustness. translated_title: 运筹学中的强化学习：技术综述与实践路线图
translated_abstract: 复杂动态系统中对实时、数据驱动决策日益增长的需求，正给传统运筹学（OR）方法带来越来越大的压力。强化学习（RL）作为一种补充方法应运而生，为动态和不确定环境下的序贯决策提供了强大的学习和计算能力。近期研究显示，人们对将强化学习与运筹学相结合的兴趣日益浓厚，以解决动态决策问题、增强组合优化的启发式方法和精确方法，并支持运营系统数字孪生的开发。这些努力的总体目标是利用强化学习的学习能力来强化传统运筹学算法，提高解的质量、计算效率和鲁棒性。鉴于集成方法和应用场景的多样性，显然需要一个系统性的技术……
tldr: 本文系统综述了强化学习与运筹学相结合的技术进展，并提出实践路线图，展示如何利用RL的学习能力提升传统OR算法在动态决策、组合优化和数字孪生中的解质量、计算效率与鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a technical review and practical roadmap for integrating reinforcement learning with operational research, demonstrating how RL's learning capabilities can enhance traditional OR algorithms in terms of solution quality, computational efficiency, and robustness for dynamic decision-making, combinatorial optimization, and digital twins.
